children: Royal Bank of Canada (TSX:RY) posted rising ROE—Q3 just above 18%, YTD 17.6%—and a 13.5% CET1 while hitting CAD 760M in HSBC synergy savings and boosting AI and revenue synergy targets, as mortgage and deposit growth, City National gains and platform consolidation drive efficiency and cross‑sell momentum.
: Royal Bank of Canada (RY): Q3 ROE just above 18%; YTD 2026 ROE 17.6% (vs 16.7% in 2025, 15.5% in 2024). CET1 ratio 13.5%. CFO cites medium-term ROE goal >17%.
: RBC (RY) reported CAD 760M in HSBC integration cost synergies ahead of plan. AI-related net benefits now expected above prior CAD 700M–1B target; revenue synergies aim toward CAD 300M.
: RY Q3: Canadian mortgage balances +4% YoY; management says pace matched guidance and drove ~half of market‑share gain. Record Avion card signups. Commercial deposits +9% YoY.
: RY Q3: 12% ROE, efficiency ratio ~low-70s. City National added CAD 184M. Management cites cost cuts, revenue growth, infrastructure and funding efficiency, plus wealth-client cross-selling.
: Royal Bank of Canada (RY) merges RBC Edge, RBC Clear and City National transaction banking into one global client platform; RBC Clear added 235+ clients, many from the S&P client base.
